1.text: Iminsi itandatu ishize, Yesu ajyana Petero na Yakobo na Yohana mwene se, bajyana mu mpinga y'umusozi muremure bonyine.

2.text: Ahindurirwa imbere yabo, mu maso he harabagirana nk'izuba, imyenda ye yera nk'umucyo.

3.text: Maze Mose na Eliya barababonekera bavugana na we.

4.text: Petero abwira Yesu ati “Mwami, ni byiza ubwo turi hano. Nushaka ndaca ingando eshatu hano, imwe yawe, indi ya Mose, indi ya Eliya.”

5.text: Akibivuga igicu kirabakingiriza, ijwi rikivugiramo riti “Nguyu Umwana wanjye nkunda nkamwishimira, mumwumvire.”

6.text: Abigishwa babyumvise bikubita hasi bubamye, baratinya cyane.

7.text: Yesu arabegera abakoraho arababwira ati “Nimuhaguruke mwitinya.”

8.text: Bubura amaso ntibagira undi babona, keretse Yesu wenyine.

9.text: Bakimanuka umusozi, Yesu arabihanangiriza ati “Ntihagire umuntu mubwira ibyo mweretswe, kugeza aho Umwana w'umuntu azazukira.”

10.text: Abigishwa be baramubaza bati “Ni iki gituma abanditsi bavuga bati ‘Eliya akwiriye kubanza kuza’?”

11.text: Arabasubiza ati “Ni ukuri ko Eliya akwiriye kubanza kuza, akagarura byose akabitunganya.

12.text: Ariko ndababwira yuko Eliya yaje ntibamumenya, ahubwo bamugira uko bashaka. N'Umwana w'umuntu ni ko bazamugira.”

13.text: Nuko abigishwa bamenya yuko ababwiye ibya Yohana Umubatiza.

14.text: Bageze mu bantu, umuntu araza aramwegera, aramupfukamira aramubwira ati

15.text: “Mwami, babarira umuhungu wanjye kuko arwaye igicuri, kiramubabaza cyane kuko kenshi cyane kimutura mu muriro no mu mazi.

17.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Yemwe bantu b'iki gihe biyobagiza batizera, nzageza he kubana namwe? Nzabihanganira kugeza ryari? Nimumunzanire hano.”

18.text: Yesu aramucyaha, dayimoni amuvamo, umuhungu aherako arakira.

19.text: Maze abigishwa begera Yesu biherereye bati “Ni iki cyatumye twebwe bitunanira kumwirukana?”

20.text: Arabasubiza ati “Ni ukwizera kwanyu guke: ndababwira ukuri yuko mwaba mufite kwizera kungana n'akabuto ka sinapi, mwabwira uyu musozi muti ‘Va hano ujye hirya’ wahava, kandi ntakizabananira. [

21.text: Ariko bene uwo ntavanwamo n'ikindi keretse gusenga no kwiyiriza ubusa.]”

22.text: Bakigenda i Galilaya, Yesu arababwira ati “Umwana w'umuntu arenda kuzagambanirwa afatwe n'abantu,

23.text: bazamwica maze ku munsi wa gatatu azurwe.”Barababara cyane.

24.text: Bagera i Kaperinawumu, abantu basoresha umusoro w'ididarakama baza aho Petero ari baramubaza bati “Mbese umwigisha wanyu ntatanga ididarakama?”

25.text: Arabasubiza ati “Arayitanga.”Yinjiye mu nzu, Yesu aramutanguranwa aramubaza ati “Utekereza ute, Simoni? Abami bo mu isi abo baka umusoro n'ihoro ni abahe? Ni abana babo cyangwa ni rubanda?”

26.text: Aramusubiza ati “Ni rubanda.”Yesu aramubwira ati “Nuko rero abana bo bibereye mu mudendezo.

27.text: Ariko kugira ngo tutababera igisitaza, jya ku nyanja ujugunyemo ururobo, ifi uri bubanze gufata uyende, uyasamure urasangamo sitateri, uyijyane uyibahe ku bwanjye no ku bwawe.”
